text:
raj.engineer: Quick one  drove to Basel for a customer day, used a park-and-ride on the Swiss side and paid cross-border tolls on the French autoroute on the way back. Receipts: parking slip, toll machine ticket (no VAT on it), and fuel receipt. Can I claim the tolls & parking + full per-diem?

emily.peopleops: Yep, park-and-ride and tolls are reimbursable when business-related. Per-diem is unaffected by parking/tolls; only meals affect per-diem. For cross-border expenses, attach currency conversion or card statement.

corey.finance: Finance caveat: for cross-border tolls that don't show VAT (most motorway tickets), we process as travel incidentals. Upload the toll ticket photo + bank card line. Category: Travel > Ground - Tolls. If you have a fuel receipt with VAT, include it separately so we can attempt VAT reclaim where applicable.

raj.engineer: The toll ticket was a paper slip with only a numeric code and amount, no vendor name. Is that acceptable?

emily.peopleops: It's acceptable if you include a photo of the slip and a short note describing route/time, and tag your manager. If possible, add a map screenshot showing the route to support business purpose.

corey.finance: We'll accept paper toll slips for amounts < $100. For larger toll totals we may ask for the highway operator confirmation. Also include odometer or mileage if you're claiming mileage instead of per-diem.

raj.engineer: I also used a rental car company insurance add-on for one-way drop-off across the border. Is that reimbursable?

emily.peopleops: Rental car collision damage waiver (CDW) and one-way drop fees that are business-related are reimbursable if approved. If you picked unnecessary upgrades, those are not. Manager approval required for add-ons that increase daily rate > 20%.

corey.finance: For rental insurance, include the rental agreement line showing the insurance fee. If charged as a block that is unclear, ask for the company rental receipt breakdown from the supplier. One-way drop fees are typically reimbursable under Travel > Car Rental.

raj.engineer: I lost the parking slip but have the parking lot email confirmation and a photo of the machine screen I took. OK?

emily.peopleops: Yes, park operator confirmations + machine photos + card statement line are fine. Mark "missing slip" in notes and tag manager.

expense-bot: Reminder: pick cost_center and project_code. Use Travel template. Missing approver will return expense.

corey.finance: Sample note you can paste:
```
Customer visit Basel 2025-09-02. Business travel by car (one-way):
- Parking: Park & Ride Birsfelden 10 (photo of machine, operator email attached)
- Tolls: Autoroute FR (paper ticket) 15
- Fuel: Shell Basel 1.24L VAT included (receipt attached)
- Rental one-way drop + insurance: 45 (rental agreement attached)
Manager @laura.sales approved 2025-09-01.
```

raj.engineer: Submitted. Thanks for the clear guidance :thumbsup:
